summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II disclosed in an Item 8.01 8-K that Evernorth Holdings Inc. (Pubco) signed a Note Purchase Agreement with NH Investment Securities Co., as trustee, to issue $30.0 million of 4.00% Convertible Senior PIK Notes due 2031, closing conditioned on and concurrent with the previously announced de-SPAC business combination under the October 19, 2025 Business Combination Agreement involving Armada, Pubco, Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC and Ripple Labs Inc. The S-4 was declared effective August 27, 2026, and the deal is expected to close in Q4 2026; watch redemption levels and PIPE financing.
